Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

  • 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 20 employees a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant

  • 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one

  • 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC

  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off

  • 🔋Recharge Period: end-of-year company-wide time off to rest and reset

  • 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you

  • 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought

  • 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase

  • 🚆 Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office

  • 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones

  • 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership

  • 🤖 Enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next

  • 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office

  • 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams

  • 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities

  • 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions

  • 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey

  • 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities

  • ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons

  • 🚲 (Ireland) Cycle to Work scheme: tax-efficient bike, gear, and safety kit

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at MoonPay
description_html:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.


Locations Supported 🌍

  • London, UK (primary)

  • Remote (Europe)

Relocation available: Case by case

Work pattern:

  • Remote across Europe, with hybrid working encouraged if you're near a Moonbase (around 2 to 3 days per week in the London office).

About the Opportunity

In this role, you'll help shape MoonPay's product and business decisions through data, combining deep analysis, experimentation, and strong stakeholder partnership to drive real impact.

You'll sit within our centralised Product Data team and work closely with Product and Engineering, owning analytics across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems and success metrics through to launching, measuring, and optimising products at scale.

Your work will directly influence product strategy, customer experience, and business health, helping teams make better, faster decisions through trusted insights and clear narratives. You'll also raise the leverage of the whole team by building reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that let the wider org self-serve reliable answers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear direction, influencing decisions, and helping shape the future of high-impact financial and crypto products.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with product and business teams to run rigorous analysis (root cause, opportunity sizing, funnel drop-off) and turn it into clear, prioritised recommendations, moving across problem areas as priorities shift.

  • Define, document, and maintain clear metric definitions and business context, so stakeholders can understand the performance of their area and AI tools can interpret our metrics correctly (e.g. Transaction Success Rate, Fraud Rate).

  • Set up tracking and monitoring for new launches and changes, and quantify and measure their impact on KPIs.

  • Build and maintain a reporting layer, with automated alerting and root cause analysis that flags when KPIs move unexpectedly and why.

  • Design, run, and interpret experiments, from A/B tests to quasi-experimental methods like difference-in-differences when randomisation isn't possible.

  • Model robust, trusted data in our dbt and BigQuery layer, safeguarding its quality through testing, documentation, and certification in collaboration with engineering.

  • Create reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that scale the team's impact and help Product and Engineering self-serve.

  • Communicate complex concepts and findings to technical and non-technical audiences across different teams, while ensuring clarity and understanding to drive critical business decisions.

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a data analyst or data scientist, preferably in a product-focused role.

  • Advanced SQL and data visualisation are second nature to you.

  • Hands-on experience building data models in a modern cloud warehouse and transformation framework (e.g. dbt with BigQuery, Snowflake), with a strong instinct for data quality.

  • A solid grasp of statistics and probability, including experiment design and interpretation (A/B and quasi-experimental methods such as difference-in-differences).

  • A working understanding of how a payments or fintech business operates, including fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, and payment success rates.

  • Comfort using AI-assisted and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, and curiosity about building reusable skills that scale your impact.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder skills. You can distill complex findings for any audience up to C-level, and lead projects independently.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Familiarity with our stack (dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Python) and AI tooling such as Claude Code.

  • Hands-on financial crime, payments, or fraud analytics experience.

  • Experience working in start-ups or scale-ups.

Bonus Points

  • A crypto-native perspective and experience with on-chain and blockchain data (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Chainalysis).

  • Experience making data self-serve for non-analysts (e.g. semantic layers, metric stores).

description_html:
Unser Mandant aus dem Raum Bielefeld ist ein international erfolgreich positioniertes, mittelständisches Produktionsunternehmen mit mehreren Auslandsgesellschaften. Im Zuge einer Neuausrichtung befindet sich auch die Finanzorganisation in einer Phase der Professionalisierung und Weiterentwicklung. Für die Gestaltung einer Group Controlling-Organisation als echter Business Partner suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die mit Herz und Hand die Konzeption vornimmt und die operative Umsetzung mitverantwortet.   • Sie optimieren die Konsolidierung der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse als Basis für die integrierte Planung und den Forecasts der mittelständischen Gruppe mit in- und ausländischen Gesellschaften nach IFRS

  • Sie entwickeln Analysen und Kommentierungen der Geschäftsentwicklung und übernehmen die qualifizierte Darstellung und Erläuterung von Planabweichungen als Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen

  • Sie sichern den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung von Abschluss- und Planungsprozessen im neuen Konsolidierungstool mit Schnittstellen zu aktuellen ERP-Systemen
  • Sie lieben die Weiterentwicklung des abteilungsübergreifenden KPI-Monitorings als Grundlage für die strategische und operative Steuerung

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling/Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung im Controlling eines internationalen und produzierenden Unternehmens
  • Sie bringen fundierte Controlling und HGB-/ IFRS-Kenntnisse mit und bewegen sich sicher im externen und internen Rechnungswesen
  • Sie haben eine hohe IT-Affinität sowie Erfahrung mit SAP CO/FI und sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse
  • Sie bewegen sich in der deutschen und englischen Sprache im beruflichen Umfeld sehr sicher
  • Sie zeichnen sich durch ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für ganzheitliche Prozesse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge aus und bringen die Bereitschaft, Veränderungsprozesse maßgeblich voranzutreiben auch mit
  • Sie überzeugen mit einer hohen Zahlenaffinität in Verbindung mit logischem und analytischem Denkvermögen, damit komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich werden
  • Sie schaffen es mit ihrer Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen und einem ausgeprägten Team-Spirit die Integration von Prozessen und Systemen mit den Menschen zu schaffenSie kommen mit ihrer eigenverantwortlichen, strukturierten und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise ans Ziel

Benefits

  • Fixum, Bonus und Firmenwagen
  • Entwicklung & Perspektiven: Flache Hierarchie, internationaler Kontext, langfristige Führungschancen, Teamausbau
  • Zusatzleistungen: Jobrad, Sport-Angebote, VWL usw.
  • Flexibilität & Infrastruktur: Grundsätzlich Homeoffice möglich, kostenfreie Parkplätze
  • Arbeitskultur: Vielfalt, Eigenverantwortung & Innovation in einem dynamischen Umfeld

Wir suchen eine Person mit Herz und Hand. Ein engagierter und pragmatischer Stil zeichnet Sie aus, denn damit passen Sie gut zu unserem Kunden.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (all genders)

description_html:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by three leading VCs (Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent €30 m Series B, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our eCommerce Solutions team. You will contribute to improving an Online Booking Engine that our partners use to allow their users to search, book, and manage their ground transportation tickets. This is a great chance for you to impact products with a great market fit and high demand.

What you'll do

  • Deliver new features in our eCommerce solutions

  • Actively participate in efforts on frontend architecture initiatives

  • Understand, plan and execute maintenance of the existing codebase

  • Create tests for frontend code

  • Mentor and guide other team members


Workplace: Berlin or Europe

We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • 5-7+ years of software engineering experience with a minimum of 4+ years of professional experience working with TypeScript and React.js

  • Experience testing with Cypress

  • Experience working with public cloud providers (GCP is preferred)

  • You are driven, ambitious, and willing to get hands-on in shaping the future of ground transportation travel

  • You show ownership and responsibility for your problem space

  • You are fluent in English, both verbal and written


What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.

  • You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company.

  • We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.

  • You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities and career growth in a small and developing company.

title: Trainee (m/w/d) im Finanzvertrieb – Karriere mit Struktur, Verantwortung und Perspektive (German Speaking)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Kevin Kehr
description_html:
Du suchst einen Berufseinstieg, der Vertrieb, Beratung und persönliche Entwicklung verbindet?
Dann ist dieses Traineeprogramm genau das Richtige für dich.

Wir suchen ambitionierte Persönlichkeiten (m/w/d), die sich im Finanzvertrieb eine langfristige Karriere aufbauen wollen, mit klarem System, praxisnaher Ausbildung und individuellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
Als Trainee wirst du von Beginn an begleitet, gecoacht und gefördert, mit dem Ziel, dich zu einer lizenzierten Finanzberaterin bzw. einem lizenzierten Finanzberater zu entwickeln.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Einstieg in die Finanzberatung: Du lernst, wie du Kundengespräche professionell führst, Bedarfe erkennst und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen anbietest.

  • Vertrieb & Kundenbetreuung: Du unterstützt bei der Akquise und Beratung von Neukunden und baust schrittweise deinen eigenen Kundenstamm auf.

  • Finanzplanung & Analyse: Du erstellst Analysen und Konzepte in den Bereichen Absicherung, Vorsorge, Investment und Vermögensaufbau.

  • Praxisnahe Ausbildung: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Beratern zusammen und lernst alle Kernprozesse im Vertrieb kennen.

  • Teamarbeit & Mentoring: Du wirst persönlich durch Kevin Kehr begleitet – mit klarer Struktur, Feedback und individueller Förderung.

Wir bieten

  • Lizenzierte Ausbildung: Vorbereitung auf zwei IHK-Abschlüsse gemäß § 34d GewO (Versicherung) und § 34f GewO (Finanzanlagen)

  • Strukturiertes Traineeprogramm: Klare Lernziele, feste Module, begleitende Schulungen und praxisnahe Umsetzung.

  • Persönliches Mentoring: Direkte Begleitung durch deinen Mentor Kevin Kehr, von der ersten Beratung bis zum eigenen Kundenstamm.

  • Hohe Verdienstmöglichkeiten: Leistungsorientierte Vergütung ohne Einkommensbegrenzung.

  • Karriere mit Perspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss – Einstieg als Finanzberater oder Entwicklung in Richtung Führungskraft.

  • Flexibilität & Eigenverantwortung: Moderne, ortsunabhängige Arbeitsweise mit klarem Fokus auf Ergebnisse.



Das bringst du mit

  • Abitur oder abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein vergleichbarer/höherwertiger Abschluss

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau oder Muttersprache)

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen

  • Zuverlässigkeit, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise

title: Senior Scaled Enablement Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Maltego
description_html:
Why we need you

Maltego helps organisations uncover complex relationships and connections across people, organisations, infrastructure, and digital assets. Our platform is used by investigators, security professionals, law enforcement agencies, and enterprises worldwide to accelerate investigations and make better decisions with connected data. As we continue to grow, we're expanding our Customer Enablement team to help more customers achieve value at scale. 
We're looking for a Senior Scaled Enablement Manager to design and lead scalable customer enablement programmes that help customers successfully adopt and expand their use of Maltego products. This role sits at the intersection of customer enablement, programme management, customer education, and product adoption. You'll create repeatable experiences that enable hundreds of customers to learn, adopt, and realise value through webinars, cohort programmes, workshops, office hours, self-service content, and usage-driven interventions. 
Rather than working with a small portfolio of strategic accounts one-to-one, your focus will be on creating programmes and systems that deliver meaningful outcomes across an entire customer segment. You'll play a key role in shaping how Maltego scales customer success and adoption as we continue to grow.


What to expect

  • Own the scaled enablement motion, designing live, repeatable programmes that drive product adoption, engagement, and value realisation.
  • Build and maintain a cohort and enablement roadmap aligned with customer needs, product priorities, and business objectives.
  • Develop and optimise repeatable scaled customer journeys that support onboarding, adoption, expansion, and re-engagement at scale.
  • Plan and deliver webinars, workshops, cohort-based training programmes, office hours, and other one-to-many customer learning experiences.
  • Create and maintain high-quality enablement content, including training materials, guides, playbooks, videos, and knowledge base resources.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to improve programme design, content creation, customer insight generation, and operational efficiency across scaled enablement initiatives.
  • Analyse customer engagement and product adoption data, using AI-assisted insights where appropriate, to identify trends, opportunities, and targeted intervention strategies.
  • Measure and improve programme effectiveness using customer feedback, usage insights, and business performance metrics.
  • Partner closely with Account Managers, Customer Enablement SMEs, Product Management, Marketing, and Operations teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Define and evolve scalable operating models, processes, and best practices that enable customer success programmes to grow efficiently with the business.


Your profile in short

Required Qualifications (Must Have)

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in Customer Success, Customer Enablement, Customer Education, Customer-facing Programme Management, Product Adoption, Training, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
  • Experience designing, delivering, and improving scalable customer programmes, including webinars, cohorts, workshops, office hours, or other one-to-many formats in a SaaS or technology environment.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, written communication, and content development skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate customer insights and usage data into actionable adoption strategies.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
  • Experience with customer success, customer education, learning management, or community platforms.
  • Experience using customer success platforms such as Planhat, Gainsight, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with product adoption analytics, customer engagement metrics, and data-driven programme optimisation.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, investigations, intelligence, OSINT, SaaS, or B2B software environments.
  • Experience creating self-service learning content, structured learning paths, or customer training curricula


Why you will love Maltego

Maltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. 
Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego: 

  • Help shape a newly evolving customer enablement function 
  • Work with unique technology used by investigators and analysts around the world 
  • Build programmes that influence customer outcomes at scale 
  • Collaborate with passionate and highly skilled colleagues across the business 
  • Have a direct impact on customer adoption, retention, and growth
 At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.


Location

Based in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 2 days per week in the office


Required documents / information

Ready to help drive the future of digital investigations? Apply now with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your experience!

title: Onboarding Manager, Cybersecurity/CTI (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Maltego
description_html:
Why we need you

The Onboarding Manager delivers exceptional onboarding experiences for an assigned portfolio of new customers, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to adoption. This role oversees onboarding from Closed Won through completion, creating and executing onboarding plans, coordinating internal teams, and tracking progress. The Onboarding Manager plays a critical role in executing tasks that support adoption and time-to-value, while capturing and sharing relevant customer feedback to improve internal processes, content, and product quality. Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Sales, Customer Success, Account Management, Product, and Engineering teams, as well as a proactive approach to achieving onboarding milestones and ensuring accountability. 

This role will largely focus on accounts that want to use Maltego for cybersecurity and CTI use cases. Domain expertise in this area is a firm requirement.


What to expect

Your key responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of onboarding projects/accounts, ensuring consistent delivery on time and with quality.
  • Conduct onboarding meetings, product demos, company presentations, workshops, and training sessions (1:1 and 1:many).
  • Partner with customers to understand their business processes, deployment goals, and requirements; provide product information and technical guidance to support those goals.
  • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and milestones; track progress and proactively address any roadblocks.
  • Effectively manage all project communication, both internally and externally.
  • Educate and enable customers on product features and best practices, supporting onboarding to deliver fast time-to-value.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to identify and eliminate onboarding risks; coordinate resources to ensure resolution.
  • Address technical issues, troubleshoot problems, and work with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Support) to provide timely solutions.
  • Gather client feedback and insights to improve the onboarding process and recommend product enhancements.
  • Build strong, lasting relationships with clients, serving as the primary point of contact during onboarding.
  • Ensure smooth hand-offs with Sales and Customer Success.
  • Maintain product and domain expertise in Maltego, OSINT, and other relevant domains
  • Up to 50% travel required


Your profile in short

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity or Cyber Threat Intelligence.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills to all levels on the customer side.
  • Strong analytical and goal-oriented mindset backed by project management skills.
  • Ability to de-escalate customer support requests and maintain a positive, goal-driven customer relationship.
  • Moderately technical, with the ability to configure SaaS solutions and provide recommendations.
  • Experience in customer onboarding, customer service, support, account management, or customer success (advantage).
  • Fluent in English (required), additional languages (German and Spanish as a priority) are an advantage.


Why you will love Maltego

Maltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations, coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. 
Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego: 

  • Play a key role in creating exceptional onboarding experiences for customers in the cybersecurity space.
  • Empower organizations to get the most value from innovative technology used to uncover threats, investigate risks, and solve complex challenges.
  • Build scalable onboarding journeys that accelerate customer adoption and success.
  • Collaborate with talented and mission-driven teams across the business.
 At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.


Location

Based in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 2 days per week in the office

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d) Dealflow
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Flex Capital Management Gmbh
description_html:
Info:

Als AI-Engineer Dealflow entwickelst und verantwortest du das Produkt bzw. Tool, mit dem wir unseren proprietären Dealflow im Investmentteam im DACH-Software- und Tech-Mittelstand aufbauen. Dein Ziel: attraktive Unternehmen und ihre Gesellschafter frühzeitig identifizieren und erreichen, idealerweise bevor ein M&A-Berater mandatiert oder ein breiter Verkaufsprozess gestartet wird.

Dabei verbindest du zwei Welten: AI-/Data-Skills und Deal Origination. Du baust die Daten-, Tool- und Reporting-Infrastruktur, auf der Market Maps, Outbound-Kampagnen, potenzielle Investments und ein skalierbarer Sourcing-Prozess aufsetzen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem FLEX Leadership Team, dem Investment Team und dem Data & AI Team zusammen und erhältst vom ersten Tag an viel Ownership für den Aufbau einer zentralen Funktion bei FLEX.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust und verantwortest das AI-Produkt/Tool, das unseren Origination-Funnel kontinuierlich mit Software- und Technologieunternehmen im DACH-Mittelstand befüllt. Du entwickelst es laufend weiter und verbesserst es iterativ.
  • Du entwickelst die Screening- und Priorisierungslogik für Targets und verbesserst deren Trefferqualität systematisch.
  • Du baust die automatisierte Datenbeschaffung und -anreicherung aus, sodass Targets mit Firmographics und Eigentümerstrukturen angereichert werden.
  • Du entwickelst Logik und Workflows, um Intent-Signale und potenzielles Verkaufsinteresse zu erkennen.
  • Du initiierst die automatisierte Multichannel-Ansprache und entwickelst die zugrunde liegenden Prozesse weiter.
  • Du baust Dashboards und Reports zu Funnel, Aktivitäten und Conversion als Grundlage unserer Sourcing- und Pipeline-Reviews.
  • Du evaluierst neue Prospecting- und Sourcing-Tools und entwickelst Ansprache, Sequenzen und unsere Messaging-Bibliothek weiter.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast eigene Tools und Automatisierungen programmiert, die produktiv im Einsatz waren, nicht nur Prototypen und Demos.
  • Du bringst mindestens 2 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer daten- und AI-basierter Produkte/Tools mit.
  • Du entwickelst selbstständig in Python und deployst mit Docker auf Azure in Produktion.
  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken und setzt selbstständig nachhaltige Datenmodelle auf.
  • Du kennst LLM-APIs (OpenAI, Claude) aus der Praxis und weißt, wie man daraus hochwertigen Output bekommt (Evals).
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Daten und weißt, worauf es bei Datenqualität und -struktur ankommt. Kenntnisse in Pipedrive, Agentensystemen sowie Frameworks wie LangGraph sind ein Plus.
  • Du denkst kommerziell: Du verstehst, warum ein Target relevant ist, und misst dich an Ergebnissen.
  • Du hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch.


Benefits

  • Raum zum Wachsen und die Möglichkeit, viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kombiniert mit halbjährlichem Feedback und einem individuellen Weiterbildungsbudget. 
  • Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch ein inspirierendes und dynamisches Umfeld und flache Hierarchien.   
  • Regelmäßige Events, ein gemeinsamer Sommerurlaub sowie verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote wie beispielsweise zweimonatliche Massage / Physiotherapie im Büro.   
  • Moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsmittel, ein Office im Herzen Berlins direkt am Park am Gleisdreieck sowie eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit gesunden Snacks, Softdrinks und einem monatlichen Friday Beer/Sekt/Wein. 
  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Möglichkeiten zur Brutto-Netto-Optimierung.  


Über uns

FLEX Capital ist ein Private Equity Fonds, der sich auf Wachstums- und Buy-out-Möglichkeiten im deutschen Software- und Tech-Mittelstand fokussiert. Hinter FLEX Capital stehen sechs Seriengründer, die mehrfach marktführende Unternehmen mit internationaler Geschäftstätigkeit aufgebaut haben. Auf dieser Basis teilt das FLEX-Team seine Erfahrungen mit Unternehmern und Management Teams, unterstützt sie Hands-on und hilft ihnen so, die gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen.


Kontakt

Join us!

title: Senior Account Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Schoene Neue Kinder
description_html:
We want you!

SNK ist eine reine B2B-Digitalagentur mit über 20 Jahren Erfahrung. Wir entwickeln digitale Plattformen, Websites, Portale, Apps und individuelle Softwarelösungen für führende Industrieunternehmen sowie stark wachsende SaaS- und Tech-Companies. 

Unser Anspruch: Beratung, Konzept und Umsetzung aus einer Hand, mit Senior-Teams, hohem Qualitätsstandard und klarer Verantwortung. 

Als Senior Account Manager (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Informations- und Kommunikationsdrehscheibe zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden 

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere wertvollsten Kundenbeziehungen, professionalisierst unser Account Management weiter und entwickelst unseren bestehenden Kundenstamm proaktiv zu neuem Wachstum. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden bringst du dich bereits in der Vertriebsphase ein, erkennst Marktlücken und Potenziale frühzeitig und führst Kundenbeziehungen strategisch – von der Erstberatung über Workshops bis zum langfristigen Ausbau.


Deine Aufgaben:

  • Kundenführung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich A-Potential-Accounts (sowie ausgewählte B-Accounts), steuerst deren Priorisierung, Ziel- und Maßnahmenplanung und erkennst ungenutzte Potenziale, um daraus neue Projekte anzustoßen und die Pipeline gezielt auszubauen. Bereits in der Pitch- und Angebotsphase gestaltest du Scope und Leistungsversprechen aktiv mit.

  • Beratung & Workshops: Du verantwortest Formate wie jährliche Kunden-Workshops und Reviews und berätst auf Basis der Zielsetzung, Budgets und internen Dynamiken deiner Kunden passgenau.

  • Schnittstelle & Enablement: Du bildest die Brücke zwischen Kunden, Geschäftsführung und Fachteams (z. B. UX, Creative, Digital Marketing) und hilfst Projektmanager:innen, Kundensignale richtig zu deuten und in die operative Arbeit zu übersetzen.

  • Risiko- & Eskalationsmanagement: Du erkennst kritische Kundensignale frühzeitig, klärst Eskalationen auf Entscheiderebene souverän und hältst den Projektteams den Rücken frei. 

  • Enger Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Du berichtest regelmäßig zu Status, NRR, Kundenqualität und relevanten KPIs und treibst im engen Austausch die Weiterentwicklung unseres Account-Management-Systems voran.


Du bringst mit:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Senior / Lead Account Management: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Betreuung und Skalierung von B2B-Bestandskunden im Agentur- oder digitalen Beratungsumfeld.

  • Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management: Du baust ab Tag 1 Glaubwürdigkeit auf C-Level und Sponsorenebene auf und bewegst dich sicher auch in komplexen, konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen.

  • Souveräne Moderation & Beratung: Erfahrung in Konzeption und Durchführung von Strategie-Workshops sowie in der zielgerichteten Moderation von Kundenterminen.

  • Ausgeprägtes Business- & Finanzverständnis: Kennzahlen wie NRR, Margen, Pipeline-Ökonomie und Kundenrentabilität sind für dich vertrautes Handwerkszeug. 

  • Analytisches Gespür & Proaktivität: Du erkennst aus scheinbar kleinen Signalen – etwa veränderten Budgetfreigaben, neuen Ansprechpartnern oder verzögerten Rückmeldungen – frühzeitig Chancen oder Risiken und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte daraus ab. 

  • Führung durch Überzeugung: Du überzeugst interdisziplinäre Teams inhaltlich für gemeinsame Ziele, auch ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis.


Deine Benefits:

  • Team & Atmosphäre: Familiäres, teamorientiertes Umfeld mit motivierten Kolleg:innen – hier entstehen Freundschaften.

  • Gute Kommunikation: Offene Feedbackkultur und kurze, unbürokratische Wege.

  • Spannende Aufgaben: Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Flexibilität: Home Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. 

  • Transparente Zeitregelung: Jede Überstunde zählt – ab der ersten Minute.

  • Teamevents: Von Dönerstag bis Kinderfasching - wir lieben unsere regelmäßigen gemeinsamen Aktivitäten. 

  • Gesundheit & Umwelt: JobRad-Angebot für nachhaltige Mobilität.


Das sind wir:

In Zahlen: 1 Headquarter, über 100 Köpfe, 16 Nationalitäten

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Reev
description_html:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus.
Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.
 
Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

description_html:
You are the one we miss!

  • As a Senior Paid Media Manager, you will be independently responsible for the strategic development, implementation, and continuous optimization of our paid media campaigns on Google Ads, Meta, TikTok Ads, and in native advertising-across the entire funnel, from awareness to performance
  • You have more than 6 years of professional experience in paid media, including several years of independent responsibility for campaign budgets in the high six- to seven-figure range
  • You will be independently responsible to the client for media planning and strategic campaign planning across channels and funnel stages, from reach and brand goals to conversion optimization
  • You will create comprehensive analyses and reports on campaign performance across the entire funnel, interpret the data at a strategic level, and derive concrete optimization and scaling measures from it
  • You’ll use modern AI-powered tools and marketing technologies to manage campaigns more efficiently, identify opportunities for optimization, and develop innovative solutions for our clients
  • You’ll manage clients independently, work with them to develop paid media strategies at the strategic level, and present campaign results and opportunities for optimization persuasively to decision-makers
  • You will correspond with and manage external partners, such as media agencies
  • You have a very good command of German (minimum C1), as our current projects are primarily conducted in German. A good command of English is a plus


What you can look forward to

  • Flexibility & trust: Hybrid working at one of our denkwerk locations & flexible working hours
  • Your health matters: Urban Sports Club membership and JobRad leasing
  • We celebrate success together: Profit sharing for all permanent denkwerk employees, big parties, and event formats
  • Your development is important to us: Training budget for new skills and training; denkwerk inspiration in form of tech talks, lunch club, resilience, AI, and design formats
  • Securing the future: 20% employer contribution to company pension plan
  • Support in all situations: advice from pme Familienservice and the Mindance app
  • More than just vacation: 31 vacation days, including three joint “denkfrei days” (Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, Carnival Monday)

  • Recommend us to others - Find Your Mate: Bring great people with you and we will thank you with a bonus
  • Discounts & goodies: Access to exclusive corporate benefits as well as free snacks, coffee, cool drinks, and fresh fruit


Ready to get started with us?

Then simply send us:

  • your resume
  • a short cover letter
  • your possible start date
  • and your salary expectations

1. Application Receipt
We carefully review your documents and forward them to the relevant department.

Second interview: in person at one of our locations
Task? If so, we will let you know in good time

3. Individual Journey
If it makes sense to take a different approach, we will be happy to work with you to tailor the application process to your individual needs.

We will get back to you as soon as possible. If you think it's taking too long, please feel free to contact us!

title: Data Protection & AI Governance Advisor (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at neoshare
description_html:
Your mission

Datenschutz 

  • Du unterstützt unsere Business Funktionen bei der Dokumentation ihrer Verarbeitungsprozessen und pflegst die Verzeichnisse nach Art. 30 Abs. 1 + 2 DSGVO.
  • Du erstellst Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments.
  • Du berätst die Fachbereiche zur datenschutzrechtlichen Ausgestaltung unserer SaaS-Produkte und internen Prozesse – insbesondere zu Datenminimierung, Mandantentrennung, Berechtigungskonzepten, Löschung und Privacy by Design.
  • Du prüfst Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge und führst Vorabprüfungen neuer Dienstleister und KI-Tools durch.

AI Governance

  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Datenbanken, Messaging, eventgetriebenen Architekturen, Containerisierung, Docker, Kubernetes oder CI/CD

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Researchgate
description_html:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

    • We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

    • There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.

    • We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.

    • You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals.

    • Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess.

description_html:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

At PPRO, Senior Software Engineers (m/w/x) make some of the most significant decisions for the company. Think of yourself as an important contributor to the success of your team, with a significant impact on the team’s product, but also on its culture and spirit. You will solve complex technical problems, participate in decisions on architecture and technical direction, support and mentor other engineers and work alongside them in the code.


What you'll do:

  • Own products and services end-to-end, from requirements till deployment in our production systems

  • Collaborate and grow in a dynamic and autonomous environment while working in small, agile teams

  • Be an integral part of a team, in addition to its culture and ways of working. Common practices include agile methodologies, pair and mob programming

  • Use the latest technologies to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale

  • Be part of a team that will take full operational responsibility for the services that you own

  • Share your knowledge and build creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices


What we look for in you:

  • Results-orientation, collaborative, pragmatic, and with a continuous improvement mindset

  • Multiple experiences working with one or more general-purpose programming languages including Java

  • Experience designing and building scalable products and services

  • Experience with the cloud (preferably AWS)

  • Great problem solving abilities

  • Working proficiency in English

  • Accounting/Fintech Domain: Experience with - or a strong interest in—the complexities of accounting systems or ledgers is a distinct advantage


Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with:

  • Java and Kotlin (latest versions)

  • Modern frameworks (Spring Boot, React)

  • Cloud-native systems (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker)

  • Event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS, Kinesis)

What's in it for you?
 
Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
 
Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
 
Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
 
Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
 
Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
 
 
Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
 
Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
 
 
Our Principles: 
 
We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
 
We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
 
We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
 
We make things better: We boldly explore  new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
 
We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

title: Head of GTM Enablement
description_html:
Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.

Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source. Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.

With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

About The Role

Obsidian is looking for a Head of GTM Enablement to own how our customer-facing teams learn, apply, and win. This role leads enablement across the full go-to-market motion: sales, technical (both pre and post sale), and BDR. The mandate is simple. Drive higher sales participation and faster revenue by shrinking ramp time, getting more reps into productive motion, making pipeline generation more efficient, and improving win rates.

This is not a content librarian or LMS administrator role. You will build and run the enablement operating system that turns strategy into consistent field execution, and you'll measure success in reps ramped, deals progressed, and quota attained rather than slides shipped or courses completed. You will report to leadership, be a trusted operating partner to the broader GTM leadership team, and partner closely with Product Marketing, Product, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and RevOps to keep the field sharp as the market for AI Security evolves.

What You'll Do

Build the enablement operating system

  • Own the strategy, structure, cadence, and execution of enablement across sales, technical, and BDR, covering onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development.
  • Design and run onboarding and personalized, role-based ramp programs built to measurably shorten the time it takes new AEs, SEs, TAMs, and BDRs to become productive.
  • Run enablement as a system with a consistent weekly, monthly, and quarterly rhythm, so the right people absorb the right knowledge at the right moment.

Sharpen field skills and deal execution

  • Enable the field on the fundamentals that move deals: relevant security and product knowledge, persona-based pain discovery, new business meeting excellence (identifying use cases, bringing social proof, and quantifying pain), competitive positioning, and closing, including how to build durable champions inside accounts.
  • Equip technical talent across pre and post sale to win the technical evaluation and drive successful proofs of value.
  • Enable the BDR motion to generate more and better qualified pipeline.

Coach from real conversations

  • Ground enablement in what is actually happening in deals. Use call intelligence such as Gong and real customer conversations, rather than certification pass rates or content engagement dashboards, as your primary signal for what is working, where reps are stuck, and what to coach next.
  • Turn those observations into specific coaching and interventions, and coach the frontline leaders so they reinforce the same behaviors.

Work AI first

  • Bring fluency in AI-driven workflows to make enablement faster and more efficient, and to systematize routine practices instead of doing them by hand.
  • Use AI and performance data to build personalized enablement tracks that meet each rep where they are, instead of one size fits all training.

Lead the function

  • Hire, develop, and lead the enablement team, and set the standard by leading from the front.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment proactively, anticipating what the field will need and getting ahead of it rather than reacting to inbound requests, and hold partners to clear commitments.
  • Bring strong program management: named owners, clear timelines, refresh cadences, and follow through.

How You'll Be Measured

We measure enablement on outcomes, not activity. Your primary indicators are:

  • Ramp time: how quickly new reps reach productivity milestones such as first pipeline generated and first deal, trending down over time.
  • Sales participation rate: the percentage of customer-facing reps in productive motion and hitting plan, and how that moves quarter over quarter.
  • Pipeline generation efficiency: more qualified pipeline produced per rep and per motion.
  • Win rates: better conversion through the funnel and at close.

Who You Are

  • You have built and scaled a GTM or revenue enablement function inside a high-growth technology company, ideally through a scaling phase.
  • You have deep experience enabling the full customer-facing org, including AEs, technical pre and post sale, and BDR or pipeline generation teams.
  • Cybersecurity industry knowledge is strongly preferred. You understand the security buyer, the enterprise deal motion, and the competitive landscape.
  • You are fluent in modern sales methodology such as MEDDIC or MEDDPICC and value-based messaging, and you have implemented it, coached leaders to it, and measured the behavior change it produces.
  • You are metrics-driven. You set baselines, instrument the motion, and manage to leading and lagging indicators.
  • You are a proven people leader who has hired, developed, and retained enablement talent.
  • You are a strong program manager who ships on time and follows through.

How You Operate

  • You get your truth from real customer conversations and deal data, not from completion reports.
  • You are a builder, not an administrator. You measure your work in behavior changed and deals progressed.
  • You are a coach. You can listen to a discovery call and give a rep an audible they can use tomorrow.
  • You see modern enablement as in the moment and systematized, not as a quarterly bootcamp or a static content page.
  • You are proactive. You see what the field needs before it is asked for and drive alignment across functions to get ahead of it.
  • You are commercially literate. You can read a forecast, spot an execution gap, and translate it into a coaching or content intervention.
  • You hold a high bar but you don't let perfect get in the way of impact.

Employee Benefits

Our competitive benefits packages are designed to support our employees' well-being, both at work and at home. Our US based employees enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation with equity and 401k
  • Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage
  • Flexible paid time off and paid holiday time off
  • 12 weeks of new parent or family leave
  • Personal and professional development resources

For more details on our US benefits, or for information on our international benefits, please see here.

Pay Transparancy

Please note that the base pay range is a guideline and for candidates who receive an offer, the base pay will vary based on factors such as work location, as well as the knowledge, skills and experience of the candidate. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for equity awards and may be eligible for sales commission or incentive compensation based on the role or function within the company.

At Obsidian, we are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and hire for talent, passion, and compassion. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to submit satisfactory proof of identity and legal authorization. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact accommodations@obsidiansecurity.com

Information collected and processed as part of any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Obsidian’s Applicant Privacy Policy.

Base Salary Range

$180,000—$230,000 USD

description_html:
Get to know us

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

The role

Ideals has been in the Virtual Data Room space since 2008 and has built a trusted reputation with clients across multiple industries in Europe, including Deloitte, and EY.

To support the next stage of Ideals VDR growth in France, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive based in Paris. Joining our French Key Accounts team, you will own the full new business sales cycle and sell directly to a wide variety of enterprise corporations across diverse industries (such as energy, pharma, biotech, telecommunications, etc.).

As a quota-carrying strategic seller, your primary goal will be to grow sales and revenue through the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts and the expansion of existing ones. You will act as an impactful industry expert, generating demand, navigating complex 6 to 9-month sales cycles, and displacing incumbents by utilizing deep discovery and consultative selling frameworks.

Compensation package: 50% base salary; 50% performance-based variable.

Why Ideals?

  • Industry-leading sales culture: Ideals ranks among the Top-10% of companies on RepVue, as rated by sales professionals. You’ll be empowered with dedicated Sales Enablement, RevOps, Marketing support, and a structured onboarding ramp.

  • Stable growth: You’ll join a profitable, bootstrapped SaaS company that is positioned to deliver 5x revenue expansion and reach unicorn status in the next 5 years. The deals you close will shape Ideals' footprint in France and feed into our global scaling ambition.

  • Sales motion built on regional nuance: You’ll be part of a European-headquartered org, with over 18 years of selling in the VDR business. You'll drive GTM in the region we understand deeply, backed by a product that already powers 10%+ of global M&A activity.

What you will do

  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline focused on the acquisition of new strategic enterprise accounts (new logos)

  • Conduct solution-based sales engagements, including client meetings, executive presentations, and product demonstrations (face-to-face and virtual)

  • Maintain "White Space" analysis and execute strategic initiatives to upsell and cross-sell within the existing customer base

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive business cases that quantify the cost of inaction and address customer priorities, pain points, and ROI

title: Expert Assurance | Courtage & IA @Panora (backed by Hexa)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Hexa
description_html:
À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

Vos responsabilités

  • Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

  • La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

  • Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger.

  • Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

  • Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

  • Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

  • Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client

  • Vous écrivez clairement et savez expliquer des concepts complexes d'assurance à des non-experts

  • Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine

  • Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez passé des années à maîtriser l'assurance et souhaitez encoder cette expertise dans un produit qui transforme l'industrie

  • L'idée de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur vous enthousiasme, pas seulement utiliser des outils, mais les construire

  • Vous êtes méticuleux, rigoureux, et mettez un point d'honneur à bien faire les choses

  • Vous aimez accompagner les clients et les aider à réussir

  • Vous voulez rejoindre suffisamment tôt pour façonner ce que doit être le courtage assisté par IA

Ce rôle n'est pas fait pour vous si

  • Vous cherchez un poste de courtage traditionnel avec un portefeuille clients et des objectifs commerciaux

  • Vous préférez la routine à la construction from scratch

  • Les détails vous ennuient

Ce qui rend ce rôle unique

  • Vous rejoignez à un stade où le produit est suffisamment jeune pour que votre expertise façonne directement son intelligence

  • Vous vérifierez et améliorerez les outputs IA en IARD, Santé, et au-delà au fil de notre expansion

  • Vous faites partie de la boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA continuellement plus intelligente

  • Vous vivez la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur — un point de vue rare dans le secteur

  • Vous êtes un membre fondateur d'une équipe qui construit l'OS IA pour les courtiers européens. Cela signifie une vraie ownership, un vrai impact, et une trajectoire qui évolue avec Panora.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Responsabilité de niveau fondateur et impact direct sur le produit

  • Votre expertise assurance devient l'intelligence du produit

  • Une place au premier rang de la transformation IA en assurance, vue de l'intérieur

  • Courbe d'apprentissage intense à l'intersection de l'assurance et de l'IA

  • Package de rémunération compétitif, incluant des equity

  • Travaillez depuis les bureaux d'Hexa aux côtés de fondateurs, d'opérateurs et d'autres startups en early stage

Processus de recrutement

  1. Call intro avec l'équipe Talent d'Hexa (30 minutes)

  2. Call fit avec Diane pour comprendre votre parcours et votre expertise (30 minutes)

  3. Un scénario assurance réel : examiner une synthèse générée par l'IA, identifier les lacunes et expliquer comment vous amélioreriez l'output (à faire chez vous + restitution de 45 minutes avec Diane et Fabian)

  4. Une rencontre avec Fabien (CTO)

  5. Un entretien avec Matthieu, Partner chez Hexa

Panora s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés sans distinction de genre, origine, identité, parcours ou orientation sexuelle.

Nous savons qu'il reste beaucoup à faire en matière de diversité dans notre secteur, c'est pourquoi nous encourageons toutes les candidatures — en particulier celles issues de milieux sous-représentés.

title: VC Analyst - Internship
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Hexa
description_html:
Today, successful software companies have two ways to support and finance their growth: the VC path, and the self-financed profitable path. For software companies that can’t or do not want to bootstrap, but haven’t managed to stay permanently on hyper-growth, the VC path is a dead-end.

At Hexa Scale, we’re on a mission to solve this: offer a new alternative to fund and scale software companies towards exponential growth.

We believe that there are great software companies, still early stages in the 1-10m€ ARR range, that sit on amazing markets with a great product, but that require a few changes to unlock their potential.

We believe that by providing them with capital and strong operational leverage, we can put them on the right trajectory, towards category-leading exponential growth. Our full manifesto.

Your role is to help us find, select and invest in those companies.

Mission

Within Hexa Scale’s team (Thibault, Augustin & Samuel), you’ll participate in the deal-flow cycle to make 2/3 successful deals a year.

Outcomes

Deal-flow: guarantee volume and reactivity

  • Perform the first analysis of Inbound leads, and therefore guarantee a <48h contact to the entrepreneurs.

  • Identify new companies that fit our investment scope each week for reach out and ensure a strong volume generation at the top of our investment funnel, target: 30 identified companies

  • Help us to enhance our outbound tooling set-up (database, automations, scraping)

Research: help perform cutting edge market deep-dives

  • Perform research on sectors that we decide to deep-dive: mapping of actors, mapping of products and features, understanding of competitive landscape, understanding of funding status and exit potential, understanding of value-creation for customers and GTM structures.

  • Participate in qualitative research with market experts: Identify, reach-out and organise calls with market experts that we may not have directly in our network, at scale. Example: generate 10+ interviews with key buyer persona on a researched market.

Company analysis: help elaborate clear pictures of our targets

  • Understand and analyse the business model, product, team, growth engine, and overall business plan of our targets. Participate in our version of the BP to understand key assumptions and risks, and generate a clear picture of the investment opportunity.

  • Support Hexa Scale’s team in both intro and due diligence calls

Competences & Profile

  • Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree of top Business/Engineering school

  • At least 1 experience in GTM, Tech M&A or an investment role (PE, VC)

  • Entrepreneurship oriented: Great doer, fast self-learner, self-starter mindset

  • Very curious about tech/software and permanently digging topics to get to the heart of things

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to articulate opinions with both numbers and concepts

  • Highly coachable: enjoying and asking for feedback and training

Process

  • 1st Intro call with our Talent Team (20min)

  • Meeting with Samuel to get to know each other and discuss about your experiences and interests (20min)

  • Business Case & Feedback session with the team (1h)

  • Reference checks & ☕ with Samuel
