salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at tink GmbH
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Du gestaltest E-Commerce-Erlebnisse, die Kunden begeistern und die Conversion messbar verbessern? Du denkst in durchgängigen User Journeys, hast einen scharfen Blick für UX/UI-Details und suchst eine Rolle mit voller Ownership für den Shop?

Dann suchst du genau uns – und wir dich! Als unser/e E-Commerce Product Owner:in bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt/Dev, Operations und Marketing. Du baust Features, die Kunden weiterbringen und die Conversion messbar heben – und machst unseren Shop damit zum Maßstab in seiner Klasse.
Deine Mission 

  • Full Ownership & UX/UI-Exzellenz: Du bist die treibende Kraft hinter unserem Webshop. Du ownsed die Produkt-Roadmap, steuerst die Features nach Business-Impact und sorgst für ein nahtloses, kundenfreundliches UI/UX-Erlebnis auf allen Devices.

  • Conversion- & Journey-Optimierung: Du drehst an den richtigen Stellschrauben über den gesamten Funnel hinweg, von der Suche über die PDP (Product Detail Page) bis zum Checkout.

  • Data-Driven Growth: GA4, BI und A/B-Tests sind deine Spielwiese. Du übernimmst die KPI-Verantwortung (CVR, AOV, Warenkorbabbrüche, RPV) und leitest daraus konkrete Hypothesen und Experimente ab.

  • Smart Features & Ökosysteme: Du entwickelst kundenfreundliche Kompatibilitäts-Filter (Matter, Apple Home, Alexa etc.) sowie intelligente Starter-Set- und Bundle-Mechaniken, die Erklärungsbedarf reduzieren und den Warenkorbwert steigern.

  • Next-Level AI-Shopping: Du verantwortest innovative KI-Features - von Guided Selling über semantische Suchen bis hin zum Conversational Smart-Home-Assistant.

  • Agile Schnittstelle: Du übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse und Business-Ziele in klare Requirements für unser Tech-, Design- und Marketing-Team und stellst die höchste Qualität bei jedem Release sicher.



Dein Profil

  • E-Commerce DNA: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im transaktionalen E-Commerce mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen bei der CVR- und Funnel-Optimierung (Du lieferst Kennzahlen, nicht nur Features!).

  • Deep Tech- & Analytics-Verständnis: Sicheres Händchen für Web-Analytics (GA4, Tracking-Konzepte, Dashboards), Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie fundiertes Verständnis von modernen E-Commerce-Architekturen (Shopware, Magento, commercetools oder Headless/APIs).

  • Kommerzieller Drive: Du denkst in Deckungsbeiträgen sowie Unit Economics und priorisierst Feature-Requests knallhart nach P&L-Impact.

  • UX/UI & Qualitätssinn: Du hast ein hervorragendes Auge für intuitive Benutzerführung und den Anspruch, nur absolut makellose, kundenfreundliche Web-Anwendungen live zu bringen.

  • AI-First Mindset: Du nutzt KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in deinem täglichen Workflow, um Analysen, Specs oder Experimente extrem schnell auf das nächste Level zu heben.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hervorragende Englischkenntnisse.
  • Office-First & Team-Vibes: Du liebst den persönlichen Austausch, schätzt schnelle Kommunikationswege und hast richtig Lust, jeden Tag gemeinsam mit deinem Team in unserem wunderschönen Office im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte zu arbeiten.

  • Nice-to-haves:

    • Erfahrung im Umfeld erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte (Consumer Electronics, Technik oder Smart Home).

    • Verständnis für Smart-Home-Standards und Plattform-Ökosysteme.

    • Gespür für Merchandising, Pricing-Schnittstellen und Margenlogik bei Sets/Bundles.


Warum wir?

tink Kultur

  • tink Mission: Wir verbinden ein erfolgreiches Geschäftsmodell mit der Mission, allen Haushalten einen Zugang zu einem nachhaltigeren und smarten Zuhause zu ermöglichen.
  • Expertise: Ein erfahrenes Management-Team mit langjährigem Hintergrund im Startup-, Industrie- und Beratungsgeschäft
  • International: Unser Team kommt aus über 30 verschiedenen Nationen
  • Diversität: Wir freuen uns über Bewerber:innen jeglicher Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, religiöser Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung und jeglichen Geschlechts. Bei uns zählen Persönlichkeit und Performance.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Regelmäßige Feedback Runden und Reviews - Deine professionelle und persönliche Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen!
  • Faire Kommunikation: Wir haben eine offene und transparente Feedback-Kultur.
  • Office Policy: Wir sind ein Presence-first Team und arbeiten gemeinsam im Büro
     
tink Benefits
  • Remote Option: Du hast die Option auf bis zu 4 Wochen Remote Work pro Jahr
  • Freizeit: Bis zu 30 Urlaubstage (nach Betriebszugehörigkeit)
  • Gehalt: Wir zahlen leistungsgerecht und fair
  • Start your day right: Wir haben eine top Kaffeemaschine, Müsli und frisches Obst
  • Fitness: Bleibe fit mit dem bezuschussten Urban Sports Club Membership
  • Shopping: Erfülle Dir einen Wunsch mit monatlichem SpendIt Card Budget
  • Fun: Regelmäßige Teamevents & eine stets gut bestückte Bar

  • Visa-Support: Wir unterstützen Kandidat:innen im kompletten Visa-Prozess

title: Werkstudent*in Data Analytics (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ZDF Digital Medienproduktion GmbH
description_html:
Stellendetails

Für unsere Standorte Mainz oder Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für bis zu 20 Wochenstunden und zunächst befristet eine*n Werkstudent*in Data Analytics (m/w/d).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verarbeitest, analysierst und visualisierst Daten aus den Bereichen Social Media, TV und Streaming
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung und Automatisierung von regelmäßigen Reports
  • Du recherchierst zu Themen wie Datenvisualisierung, Dashboarding-Tools oder Markt- und Metrikbeobachtung im Bereich Social Media und Streaming
  • Du unterstützt bei der Konzeptionierung und Analyse des Trackings unserer digitalen Produkte (Web und App)
  • Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung und Konzeption von Datapipelines für die Nutzung strukturierter und unstrukturierter Daten auf Basis von Datenverarbeitungssystemen aus dem Medienumfeld und der Webanalyse


Dein Profil

  • Du absolvierst derzeit ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Medienwissenschaften, Soziologie, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Statistik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang mit quantitativer Ausrichtung
  • Du hast Kenntnisse und eine Affinität zu statistischen Verfahren und datengetriebenen analytischen Methoden
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich der Datenvisualisierung
  • Du kannst komplexe Problemstellungen aufnehmen und arbeitest zusammen mit dem Team an Lösungen
  • Du kannst dich sehr gut selbst strukturieren und deine Arbeit eigenständig priorisieren
  • Du bringt eine Leidenschaft für Medien mit
  • Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen wie z. B. Python, Go, Scala, etc. oder mit Cloud-Infrastrukturen (z. B. GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Du besitzt vorzugsweise erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Web Tracking (z. B. Google Analytics oder Matomo), Design/Gestaltung oder Dashboarding-Tools (z. B. Power BI, Tableau)
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Unser Angebot an dich

Bei uns erwartet dich ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum für eigenverantwortliches Handeln. Zusammen mit dem motivierten und engagierten Team arbeitest du an spannenden Aufgaben und abwechslungsreichen Themen. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von einem offenen Austausch, einem entspannten, aber professionellen Miteinander und flachen Hierarchien. Hier erwartet dich ein attraktiver und moderner, ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz sowie eine grüne Büroumgebung. Damit du Studium-, Arbeits- und Privatleben bestmöglich kombinieren kannst, besteht nach Absprache mit deiner Führungskraft die Möglichkeit zur flexiblen Arbeitszeitgestaltung und Mobile Office. Neben Flexibilität, netten Kolleg*innen und einladenden Büros kannst du dich außerdem auf regelmäßige Firmenevents und vieles mehr freuen.


Kontakt

Da sich unser Content an eine vielseitige Gesellschaft richtet, möchten wir auch in unseren Teams die gesellschaftliche Vielfalt repräsentieren. Auch, wenn du unserem Anforderungsprofil nicht zu 100% entsprichst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich durch deinen Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Arbeitsproben und ein Motivationsschreiben kennenzulernen. Wir freuen uns außerdem, wenn du uns neben deiner Gehaltsvorstellung auch dein frühestmögliches Eintrittsdatum verrätst.
 
 Deine Ansprechpersonen:
 Jana, Yvonne & Marius (Fachabteilung) 
 Nina (Recruiting)
 
Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Working Student – Visual Design / Communication Design(gn), starting at 12h per week, hybrid (Munich)
description_html:
What You'll Do

  • You help us bring the topics of heat pumps, energy-efficient renovations, and 42watt to life.
  • You work on exciting communication formats for web, social media, and print — from (info) graphics and layouts to templates and animations.
  • You expand our visual language with concrete assets and strengthen the visual foundation of our brand.
  • You translate briefs and content into production-ready files.


Your profile

  • You are studying communication design, graphic design, visual communication, or a related field.
  • You have a strong visual sense for branding and work consistently within existing brand guidelines.
  • You are proficient in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, and ideally Photoshop).
  • You enjoy working hands-on on clearly defined tasks with regular output.
  • You are interested in the energy transition and sustainable technologies.

Nice to have:

  • Initial experience with motion graphics (After Effects, Figma).
  • You enjoy experimenting with creative workflows beyond the standard — for example, using AI-powered tools for image generation, asset variation, or automating routine tasks.


Unsere Benefits

  • Flexible work with clear structure: Two fixed home office days and three days in the office — and we actually live by it. With trust-based working hours, you can organize your workday independently and focus on results.
  • 30 vacation days + workation: In addition to 30 vacation days, you can work up to one week per year from another EU country upon agreement.
  • Modern work environment: You’ll work with a latest-generation MacBook in a modern office featuring call zones, quiet zones, and phone booths. Espresso machine coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available.
  • Monthly tax-free benefit: €50 per month (from 30 hrs/week) or €25 (under 30 hrs/week) — flexible to spend on what matters most to you.
  • Team culture with real exchange: Regular team events and our biweekly breakfast meet-up foster transparency, collaboration, and a strong sense of togetherness.
  • Dog-friendly office: Your office-friendly dog is welcome here.
  • Meaningful work with measurable impact: You actively contribute to the energy transition in the building sector and work on solutions that create lasting sustainable impact.


Gleiche Chancen für alle

At 42watt, we foster an open and inclusive company culture. We believe that diversity and equal opportunity are key to our success. That’s why we create a work environment that promotes equal opportunities and supports diversity at every level. We explicitly encourage people of all genders, cultural backgrounds, age groups, and abilities to apply. Our goal is to build a diverse team that embodies our values and drives creative ideas forward.

title: Automation Engineer (gn) - 40 Std, (hybrid) (München)
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

​Wir arbeiten über ein zertifiziertes Netzwerk lokaler Handwerkspartner – ohne eigene Installationskapazitäten. Der Erfolg unseres Geschäftsmodells hängt direkt davon ab, wie gut wir dieses Partnernetzwerk aufbauen, auslasten und kommerziell steuern. Für diese zentrale Rolle suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die unser Partnership Team leitet und gleichzeitig operativ in wichtige Verhandlungen mit Handwerkspartnern, OEMs und Großhandel eingebunden ist. Das Partnership Management ist eine Kernfunktion bei 42watt – zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Du treibst den deutschlandweiten Ausbau unseres Handwerkspartner-Netzwerks voran, gewinnst neue und entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften weiter und schaffst damit die notwendigen Kapazitäten für das weitere Wachstum von 42watt.

  • Du verhandelst Preise, Projektvolumina, Kapazitäten und Rahmenbedingungen mit unseren Handwerkspartnern und stellst wirtschaftlich attraktive und langfristig erfolgreiche Partnerschaften sicher.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im Partner-/Account-Management: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Partner- oder Account-Management mit (operativer oder Einkaufs-Schwerpunkt), idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Verhandlungsstärke: Du bist ein exzellenter Verhandler und hast nachweislich erfolgreich Preis-, Volumen-, Kapazitäts- und Rahmenvertragsverhandlungen geführt.

  • Kommerzielles Denken: Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge hinter einem Partnernetzwerk und steuerst konsequent entlang von Umsatz, Marge, Kapazität und Auslastung.

  • Führungserfahrung: Du bringst Führungserfahrung in der Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Teams mit und schaffst klare Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Strukturen.

  • Ownership & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du denkst strategisch, setzt aber genauso gerne selbst um – vom wichtigen Partnergespräch und der Verhandlung bis zur Verbesserung eines operativen Prozesses.

  • Scale-up-Mindset: Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Strukturen schnell verändern, nicht jeder Prozess bereits definiert ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist.

  • Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern – vom Handwerksbetrieb über Großhandel und OEMs bis hin zu internen Führungskräften.

  • Sonstiges: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools und CRM-Systemen.

  • Nice to have: Ein tiefes Verständnis der Prozesse und Dynamiken im Handwerk (bevorzugt SHK oder Elektro), idealerweise erworben im Handwerksumfeld, Großhandel oder Partnermanagement.


Unsere Benefits

  • Flexibel arbeiten: 2 Tage Home Office, 3 Tage im Büro und Vertrauensarbeitszeit geben dir Flexibilität und gleichzeitig eine klare gemeinsame Struktur.

  • Dogs welcome: Dein bürotauglicher Hund ist bei uns im Office herzlich willkommen.


Unser Interview Prozess

  • Kennenlern-Call (ca. 30 Min)

Gleiche Chancen für alle

Bei 42watt leben wir eine offene und inklusive Unternehmenskultur. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Diversität und Gleichberechtigung der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg sind. title: Senior Projektsteuerer (m/w/d) – Bauprojekte & Projektmanagement
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Skalbach GmbH
description_html:
Firmenprofil

Unser Mandant ist ein etabliertes und zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich der Planung, Steuerung und Realisierung anspruchsvoller Bauprojekte. Mit einem interdisziplinären Team begleitet das Unternehmen Projekte über verschiedene Leistungs- und Projektphasen hinweg und verbindet dabei fachliche Expertise mit einer partnerschaftlichen Zusammenarbeit. Ein modernes und offenes Arbeitsumfeld bietet erfahrenen Fachkräften die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ihre Expertise gezielt einzubringen. Individuelle Weiterentwicklung, fachlicher Austausch und eigenständiges Arbeiten haben dabei einen hohen Stellenwert. Zur Verstärkung des Teams wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im Bereich Projektsteuerung gesucht.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie übernehmen die Projektsteuerung anspruchsvoller Bauprojekte und verantworten dabei insbesondere die Bereiche Termine, Kosten und Qualität
  • Sie klären gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten die Aufgabenstellung und koordinieren die Anforderungen der Nutzer und Bauherren
  • Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich einzelne Handlungsbereiche der Projektsteuerung, beispielsweise die Erstellung und Überwachung von Termin-, Organisations- und Zahlungsplänen
  • Sie koordinieren die unterschiedlichen Projektbeteiligten und stellen eine strukturierte Kommunikation sowie transparente Dokumentation sicher
  • Sie begleiten Genehmigungsverfahren und stimmen sich hierzu mit Behörden und weiteren relevanten Ansprechpartnern ab
  • Sie überprüfen die Leistungen der Planungsbeteiligten hinsichtlich Qualität, Vertragserfüllung und Einhaltung der definierten Projektziele
  • Sie vertreten die Projektleitung bei Besprechungen und übernehmen eine aktive Rolle in der Abstimmung mit Bauherren und Projektpartnern
  • Sie begleiten die Qualitätssicherung in der Ausführung durch regelmäßige Baustellenbegehungen
  • Sie unterstützen bei der Fortschreibung der Planungsziele, der Lösung von Zielkonflikten sowie bei der frühzeitigen Vorbereitung notwendiger Entscheidungen
  • Sie wirken bei der Akquise und Bearbeitung neuer Projekte mit und bringen Ihre fachliche Erfahrung bereits in der Projektanbahnung ein


Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen, Baumanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Planung, Projektsteuerung oder im Bauprojektmanagement
  • Erfahrung in der Koordination und Steuerung komplexer Bauprojekte
  • Gute Kenntnisse im Planungs-, Bau- und Werkvertragsrecht, insbesondere HOAI, VOB und BGB
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und MS Project
  • Ausgeprägtes Organisationsvermögen sowie eine strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Verhandlungsgeschick im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Projektbeteiligten
  • Freude daran, komplexe Aufgabenstellungen zu analysieren und gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln
  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie ein professionelles und verbindliches Auftreten


Benefits

  • Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Projekte: Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle in vielseitigen Bauprojekten und können Ihre Erfahrung direkt in deren erfolgreiche Steuerung einbringen.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum statt Routine: Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich, treffen Entscheidungen und gestalten Abläufe sowie Projektstrukturen aktiv mit.
  • Breites Aufgabenspektrum: Von Kosten und Terminen über Qualitätssicherung bis zur Kommunikation mit Bauherren und Projektbeteiligten erwartet Sie eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit.
  • Fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Regelmäßige Schulungen und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten unterstützen Sie dabei, Ihre Expertise kontinuierlich auszubauen.
  • Interdisziplinärer Austausch: Sie arbeiten eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und erfahrenen Projektpartnern zusammen und profitieren von einem vielseitigen fachlichen Umfeld.
  • Moderne Arbeitskultur: Ein offenes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld schafft kurze Kommunikationswege und ermöglicht eine unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Persönliche Entwicklungsperspektive: Ihre individuellen Stärken und beruflichen Ziele werden berücksichtigt und bieten Ihnen langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Neben einer attraktiven Vergütung erwarten Sie zusätzliche Mitarbeiter-Benefits.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Sie werden Teil eines etablierten Unternehmens, in dem Eigeninitiative, Expertise und nachhaltige Zusammenarbeit geschätzt werden.


Kontakt

Sie möchten anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte aktiv steuern und Ihre Erfahrung in einem vielseitigen Projektumfeld einbringen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen und Ihnen die Position sowie die Rahmenbedingungen persönlich vorzustellen. Im gesamten Bewerbungsprozess begleiten wir Sie transparent, professionell und persönlich – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung.

description_html:
Firmenprofil

Unser Mandant ist ein international agierendes Unternehmen, das sich auf Projektsteuerung, Baumanagement und die erfolgreiche Realisierung komplexer Bauvorhaben spezialisiert hat. description_html:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years. Your mandate is to make capability grow as fast as headcount without lowering the bar for customer work.

You will own:

  • Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

  • Onboarding: Build a clear path from a new hire’s first week to independent customer work.

  • Technical bootcamps: Turn new products, research, and field methods into practical training for customer work.

  • Strategic bootcamps: Empower client-facing teams of FDEs to drive business and strategic discussions and to set up for success large partnership programs with customers

  • Program ownership: Own the roadmap, curriculum, contributor model, regional delivery, tools, measurement, and central team.

  • Scaling: Launch useful programs now, then adapt them for larger cohorts without making the content generic or relying on a small group of experts.

  • Team building: Launch the first programs, build a network of instructors, and hire the team needed to support several hundred FDEs.

  • Cross-functional work: Work with functional managers, Product, Engineering, Science, People, GTM Enablement, DevRel, and regional leaders.

  • Readiness standards: Ensure FDEs in every region meet the same standard, can find current material, learn from recent customer work, and understand expectations at the next career level.

  • Knowledge structuration: Ensure internal resources are up to date and pushed to the right stakeholders with a knowledge management approach.

How We Work in Solutions

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

  • You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

  • You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

  • You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

  • You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

  • You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

  • You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

  • You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

  • You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

Ideally, you have

  • Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

  • Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

  • Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

  • Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

  • Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

  • Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

  • Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

  • Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

  • Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

  • Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.

Why this role matters

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

What You Will Do

  • Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

  • Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

  • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

  • Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

  • Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a founding people-leadership role. There is no team to inherit and no legacy to maintain — you build the team as well as the stack, and you are accountable for both from day one. Early on you will be deliberately hands-on, because there is no one else to solve the hardest problems — but hiring your first engineers, coaching them, and setting their growth paths starts immediately, not later. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will be the founding Engineering Team Lead for storage on our cloud.

Block, filesystem, and object storage for training runs, sandboxed workloads, and general compute: you decide what we build, what we buy, and how it adds up to storage our customers can bet a business on. Some layers we deploy and harden from best-in-class vendors. The ones that matter most we write ourselves in Go — S3-compatible object storage, tiering, backup and recovery, caching layers that put cold data on cheap spinning disks.

As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You will own capacity planning across datacenters and the architecture that keeps data durable when disks, networks, and entire sites fail. Storage is a strategic bet for this org: the team you build and the calls you make will define how a gigawatt of European compute stores its data.

What You Will Do

  • Stand up the storage stack — block, file, object — for training, sandbox, and general compute workloads.

  • Make the build-vs-buy calls: deploy and harden vendor platforms where they win; design and write our own services in Go where they don't.

  • Own the data plane: allocation, duplication, tiering, backup and recovery, S3-compatible APIs.

  • Plan capacity across datacenters and across failure domains — petabytes, not terabytes.

  • Build the team from zero: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own performance and growth paths, and set the standard for ownership.

  • Partner with Product Managers to shape the storage roadmap and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have built storage systems — object, block, or distributed filesystems — not just operated them. You know what happens when a disk dies mid-write and when a rebalance collides with a backup window.

  • Deep distributed-systems fundamentals: durability, consistency, replication, erasure coding, failure domains.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Systems engineers coming from C++ or Rust who are ready to write Go daily should still talk to us.

  • You are comfortable with hardware reality: HDD, SSD, and NVMe tiers, and the economics of each.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

title: Engineering Team Lead, Fleet Delivery
description_html:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.

What You Will Do

  • Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

  • Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

  • Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

  • Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

  • Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.

What We're Looking For

  • You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it.

  • Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction.

  • Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

description_html:
Dans le cadre du développement de nos équipes de gestion, nous recherchons un·e Gestionnaire de Copropriété Volant·e pour intervenir en renfort sur les portefeuilles en Île-de-France.

Ce poste a vocation à assurer la continuité de service sur les portefeuilles temporairement sans gestionnaire titulaire (remplacement, vacance de poste, surcroît d'activité, transition entre deux gestionnaires). Le/la gestionnaire volant intervient successivement sur différents portefeuilles, avec la même exigence de qualité et d'autonomie qu'un gestionnaire titulaire.

Concrètement, tu seras en charge de :

  • Gestion administrative, juridique et technique des copropriétés confiées (portefeuille pouvant varier selon les besoins)

  • Préparation, convocation et tenue des assemblées générales, rédaction et diffusion des procès-verbaux

  • Mise en œuvre et suivi des décisions votées en assemblée générale

  • Relation avec les conseils syndicaux : conseil, reporting, points réguliers

  • Suivi des sinistres, des contrats fournisseurs et des travaux (devis, suivi de chantier, réception)

  • Gestion des impayés et suivi des procédures contentieuses en lien avec les équipes juridiques et comptables internes

  • Visites d'immeubles et suivi technique du patrimoine (état général, sécurité, conformité réglementaire)

  • Gestion des demandes courantes des copropriétaires et occupants via les outils Matera

  • Reprise et prise en main rapide d'un portefeuille (analyse du dossier, priorisation des sujets en cours, historique des irritants)

  • Transmission structurée du portefeuille au gestionnaire titulaire lors de son arrivée (passation complète et documentée)

Avantages :

  • Politique d’accompagnement à la parentalité : une reprise en douceur à 80% pendant 4 semaines (payées à 100%), ainsi que 5 jours de congés supplémentaires par an pour enfant malade,

  • Congé Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables,

  • Congés menstruels : 1 jour de congé payé supplémentaire par mois, pour mieux gérer les règles douloureuses,

  • Sport : Accès à Wellpass pour faire du sport à petits prix,

  • Avantages CSE Leeto : des bons plans culture (réductions cinéma, musées, parcs d’attraction…).

  • Politique de télétravail : 2 jours de présence au bureau par semaine. Attention, sur ce poste des déplacements sont à prévoir pour visiter les copropriétés clientes,

  • Un parcours carrière pour t’accompagner dans ton évolution professionnelle : accompagnement hebdomadaire par ta·on manager, 2 performances reviews par an, et politique de mobilité interne,

  • Un ordinateur et téléphone professionnel (Appel) + prise en charge des frais kilométriques,

Informations Pratiques :

  • Bureaux situés à Paris ; déplacements à prévoir en Ile-de-France

  • Contrat : CDI, statut cadre forfait jours

  • Rémunération : 54 à 59K


  • Formation Bac+2 à Bac+5 en immobilier, droit ou gestion (BTS Professions Immobilières, licence/master droit immobilier, etc.)

  • Expérience confirmée en gestion de copropriété (syndic), idéalement 4 ans minimum

  • Bonne connaissance de la loi de 1965, du décret de 1967 et de la réglementation copropriété

  • Sens du service, aisance relationnelle et pédagogie face aux copropriétaires et conseils syndicaux

  • Capacité d'adaptation, réactivité et goût pour la polyvalence (changement de portefeuille, contextes variés)

  • Rigueur, autonomie et bon sens de la priorisation

  • Permis B et véhicule pour les déplacements sur site en Île-de-France

Processus de recrutement :

1️⃣ Échange avec notre recruteuse (20min par téléphone)

2️⃣ Rencontre équipe et managers (1h à 1h30) 

3️⃣ Prise de références et offre.

À savoir :
🕑 Nous nous efforçons de faire un retour sur ta candidature le plus rapidement possible (sous une semaine). Que le retour soit positif ou négatif, tu recevras un mail de notre part - pense à regarder tes spams au cas où.
☝️ Si tu as besoin de prédispositions particulières pour réaliser les entretiens dans les meilleures conditions, tu peux le notifier lors de ta candidature et en informer l’équipe Recrutement.

description_html:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The mission of the Senior Product Manager - Earn is to own and grow one of Ledger Live's core value pillars: helping millions of users put their crypto to work safely, directly from self-custody. You will define and drive the roadmap for Earn - spanning staking, stable yield savings, and partner-powered yield products - turning Ledger's security promise into a real, recurring source of value for our users and for the business.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Driving initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration — writing PRDs, defining success metrics, and partnering closely with engineering, design, and embedded software to ship features that work flawlessly on both the app and the device.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Using Mixpanel and other analytics tools to understand user behavior across the Earn funnel, identify drop-off points, and prioritize the roadmap based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Partner & Ecosystem Management: Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what “earning with Ledger” means for our users.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance — especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.

  • Team & Stakeholder Communication: Producing sharp, decision-ready documentation (roadmaps, product vision docs, dashboards) that can be handed directly to leadership and collaborators without further editing.

What we’re looking for:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance — especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.

  • Team & Stakeholder Communication: Producing sharp, decision-ready documentation (roadmaps, product vision docs, dashboards) that can be handed directly to leadership and collaborators without further editing.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

title: Founding Data Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Meetdavis
description_html:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

description_html:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

We are looking for a Digital Customer Success for our new Pro offer!
 

Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Execute a high-volume engagement approach, utilizing 1-to-many strategies such as targeted email sequences, digital materials and webinars (from onboarding to renewal) 
  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of accounts, ensuring customers hit key milestones in their journey (via emails and meetings)
  • Manage renewal discussions with strong focus on client retention and growth
  • Monitor customer health scores and relevant data to proactively identify and engage at-risk accounts.
  • Drive customer adoption of key best practices by helping on enablement sessions and webinars. 
  • Contribute to the development of the digital resources and "Digital Journey" content that empowers customers to find value independently. 
  • Identify common customer challenges and provide feedback to Product and Engineering to improve the customer experience. 
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales and Customer Experience teams to mitigate risk, improve customer experience, drive value outcomes, and unlock growth

    • Who you are:
  • Relevant work experience of at least 2 years as a Customer Experience, CSM or Marketing Project Manager
  • Excellent presentation, written, and oral communication skills in French
  • Customer-centric
  • Good marketing knowledge
  • Strong ability to understand, manage, and drive customers' needs and strategy 
  • Proven track record of sustained target achievement
  • Ability to drive issue resolution and work in collaboration with all departments (Sales, Product, Customer Experience, Finance, etc.)
  • Proactive, autonomous, and efficient!
  • You're a data-driven person as well as a team player

    • Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works : Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and Several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform
  • A culture that cares : From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

description_html:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Global Sellers Team mission at Back Market is to enable a stable supply of high quality refurbished products to our 17 markets. The team is fast-growing, we onboard and nurture great sellers to unlock the right products that our customers want.

As a Business Development Intern, your main priorities center on qualifying and completing the onboarding journey with Asian sellers. After activation, you will grow sellers’ business including working with sellers to maximize product selection and acting as a trustworthy bridge between internal stakeholder teams and sellers to deliver the best e-commerce experience for customers on Back Market.

You will be able to contribute to overall business by leading BD enablement projects that unleash the potential of sellers to scale up.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Qualify and onboard new sellers to contribute to Back Market’s selection growth

  • Manage newly activated sellers through a hybrid approach of dedicated 1:1 account management and pooled coverage, focusing on Sellers GMV & Quality performance to ensure a profitable and healthy growth for both seller and Back Market

  • Partner with internal functional teams (quality, logistics, finance, legal etc) to support new sellers

  • Constantly explore top sellers on competitors' platforms with global supply origin, including Hong Kong/China/Asia, etc.

  • Support on BD seller communication, including 1) be part of the taskforce to lead on seller recruitment or education webinars; 2) developing Chinese/English content library of BD enablement materials

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are looking for a 6-months internship

  • English and Mandarin are no-brainers (fully professional capability in English and Mandarin). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • Excellent in time management with great sense of priority and ownership

  • Detail-oriented and active listener

  • Good organization & communication skills

  • You have an analytical and critical thinking mind - strong use of insights for decision making

  • Abilities to work independently with highly self-motivation. Positive learning attitude is must-have

  • Interested in engaging with small to medium-sized businesses and e-commerce, you ideally have a previous experience in a related field

  • Experience in content creation and live broadcasting is a plus

  • Interested in fast-growing start-ups preferred

  • Salesforce, SQL, and/or Tableau experience is a plus, but readiness to learn a must

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement provided by your French school is required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager

  • Home assignment

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1.2K – €1.4K per month

  • • Paris-based Internship salary range, depending on study level €1.2K – €1.4K per month

The Trade-In service enables customers to sell their old devices (smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, Back Market’s network professional refurbishers. This is great for the consumer who can reclaim cash for their old device and prevent the accumulation of e-waste in our landfills. Trade-In is also a key pillar for Back Market as it facilitates the sourcing of tech devices to be refurbished and sold on our website.

BuyBulk is Back Market's centralized Trade-in service where a single professional processing partner receives, tests and grades all incoming devices on behalf of the refurbishers. Instead of each refurbisher individually sourcing and processing trade-in devices, BuyBulk handles the entire operational process and ships the tested devices in bulk. This service removes the sourcing burden and lets professionals focus on what they do best: refurbishing and selling.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

Play a key role in ensuring Buybulk performance reaches targets on a daily / weekly / monthly basis by:

  • Tracking and monitoring KPIs to help the team understand performance drivers and take relevant actions: you will support the team in regular reporting, one-off analyses on specific topics and continuous improvement of reporting and tools

  • Being in charge of key operational processes and checks to ensure a steady performance and customer satisfaction

Support the team on major projects - examples of projects and topics you could work on:

  • Improving efficiency through automation (simplify / automate processes, reportings, analyses, alerting …)

  • Build new or improve existing processes, tools and reports on ad-hoc projects (quality control, customer care, pricing, …)

  • Participate in structuring large projects by identifying opportunities (benchmark, research, …), setting up action plans, identifying stakeholders (within teams such business development, marketing or product), defining timelines and success factors and regularly following up on progress

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are looking for a 6-month internship

  • English and French fluency (fully professional capability).

  • You have advanced analytical and data manipulation skills and exceptional attention to written, visual, and quantitative detail

  • Ideally you have previous experience (internship, freelance, apprenticeship) as a business analyst, country or category manager, operations manager (logistics, customer care, …), seller success manager, investment banking or consulting intern/junior and you are looking for a hands-on experience allowing you to have a concrete impact on the business.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de ses équipes, notre client bancaire CIB recherche un profil Citizen Developer / AI & Data Use Cases afin d’accélérer le développement et le déploiement de solutions combinant expertise métier, développement technique et Intelligence Artificielle.

🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈

___________________________________________________________________


Le poste

InsideBoard est la plateforme d'IA dédiée à la conduite du changement. Nous accompagnons l'adoption et la performance chez les plus grandes entreprises mondiales (Stellantis, General Motors, Michelin, La Poste, Pernod Ricard, et d'autres).
En tant que Solution Engineer, vous êtes le pont technique entre nos clients et la plateforme : vous participez aux ateliers client, vous captez les besoins, puis vous utilisez le développement assisté par IA (Claude Code, Windsurf et notre outillage d'agents interne) pour configurer, intégrer et étendre la plateforme InsideBoard, souvent dans la même semaine.

Ce n'est pas un poste d'ingénieur logiciel classique, et vous n'avez pas besoin de maîtriser toutes les technologies de notre stack. Vous orchestrez des agents IA sur un écosystème interne bien documenté (surface d'API, automatisation n8n, conventions pensées pour les agents).
L'IA écrit la majeure partie du code ; votre travail consiste à savoir ce qu'elle fait, à vérifier qu'elle fait la bonne chose, et à l'arrêter quand ce n'est pas le cas. Et vous portez la relation client sur le volet technique.

Vos missions

Face au client (environ 50 %)

  • Animer des ateliers de cadrage et de spécification avec des clients grands comptes (en français et en anglais), du kickoﬀ aux comités de pilotage (COPIL).
  • Transformer les réunions en livrables actionnables : spécifications fonctionnelles, matrices de statut, wireframes, guides d'intégration, guides utilisateur, comptes rendus avec décisions validées.
  • Défendre des arbitrages face au client : configuration standard ou développement spécifique, vision cible ou solution pragmatique, et assumer la recommandation.
  • Répondre aux revues de sécurité et aux questions de due diligence technique ; rédiger des analyses de cause racine en cas d'incident de production.

Configuration de la plateforme et données (environ 50 %)

  • Configurer la plateforme InsideBoard via son interface d'administration ou ses API : KPIs (formules, agrégation, fréquences), plans d'action et programmes de coaching, challenges, guidance, sections de profil, champs personnalisés, formulaires, notifications, imports d'utilisateurs, de départements et de tags.
  • Construire et maintenir des workflows d'automatisation n8n : webhooks, tâches planifiées, synthèses générées par IA, pipelines de contenu RAG, alerting d'erreurs centralisé vers Slack.
  • Scripter des opérations de données en Python ou TypeScript : migrations en masse avec discipline dry-run et rollback, audits de licences, rapports d'engagement, échanges Excel/CSV/SFTP avec les DSI clientes.
  • Brancher des fonctionnalités LLM pour les clients : synthèses de performance générées par IA, pipelines OCR, bases de connaissances RAG, conception de prompts d'agents.
Le profil recherché

Vous n'avez pas besoin de connaître toutes les technologies que nous utilisons. Il vous faut assez de profondeur technique pour superviser une IA qui les connaît : comprendre son plan, poser les bonnes questions, repérer quand elle dérive, et valider le résultat avant qu'il n'atteigne un client.

Indispensable

  • Une vraie maîtrise des agents de code IA (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf ou équivalent) : vous savez spécifier une tâche précisément, piloter l'agent, relire sa production avec un œil critique et vérifier le résultat. Vous savez aussi quand ne pas lui faire confiance.
  • Une capacité de contrôle technique : vous lisez un diﬀ ou un log suﬃsamment bien pour comprendre ce qui a changé et pourquoi, vous suivez un appel API de bout en bout, vous vérifiez la cohérence d'une transformation de données et vous testez ce que l'IA a construit avant de livrer.
  • Écrire du code de zéro n'est pas exigé.
  • Une aisance avec les API REST : authentification, pagination, rate limits ; à l'aise avec la plomberie de données JSON/CSV/XLSX.
  • Une excellente communication client en français et en anglais : vous savez animer un atelier, recadrer avec diplomatie et écrire des documents qu'un DSI lira.
  • De la rigueur et de la prudence avec les données de production : dry-runs, plans de rollback,logs. Vous faites mesurer deux fois à l'IA avant toute mise à jour en masse.
Un plus
  • Une expérience de développement (TypeScript, Python), utile mais non requise.
  • Une expérience avec n8n, Zapier, Make ou une plateforme d'automatisation similaire.
  • Une exposition aux écosystèmes d'entreprise : Salesforce, Dynamics 365, SAP , SSO.
  • Une expérience d'intégration LLM (API OpenAI/Anthropic/Mistral, RAG, conception de prompts).
  • Un passé en adoption SaaS, conduite du changement ou customer success engineering.
 
Processus de recrutement :
Un appel initial de 15 minutes sera programmé avec Shelly dès que votre candidature sera approuvée puis un entretien RH avec Shelly de nouveau.
Ensuite, vous aurez un entretien d'une heure pour discuter de vos expériences, motivations et de notre entreprise avec  Sébastien
Vous rencontrerez votre future manager, Manan, pour discuter plus en détail du rôle, de vos compétences et de ce que nous pouvons vous offrir.
Enfin, un appel téléphonique avec Michael, l'un des directeurs d'InsideBoard AI, clôturera le processus.
 
Ce que nous offrons
• Une opportunité de travailler dans une entreprise innovante et en pleine croissance.
• Un environnement de travail collaboratif et stimulant.
• Des possibilités de développement professionnel et de montée en compétences.
• Des événements d’équipe réguliers et une culture d’entreprise conviviale.

La mission s’inscrit dans un programme de digitalisation du parcours After Sales, avec pour objectif d’optimiser les communications adressées aux clients tout au long du parcours de prise en charge d’un produit en service après-vente.

La solution s’appuie sur Salesforce Marketing Cloud pour orchestrer les différentes notifications clients, notamment sur les canaux Email et SMS, dans un contexte international et multi-marchés.

  • Capacité à comprendre et challenger la faisabilité d’une demande dans SFMC ;
  • Expérience en recette fonctionnelle, tests end-to-end et UAT ;
  • Maîtrise de Jira ou d’un outil équivalent ;
  • Une expérience sur des projets de roll-out internationaux est un vrai plus. 
  • Une maitrise de l'anglais professionnel courant, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est indispensable pour cette mission, les échanges s’effectuant régulièrement dans un contexte international.

Les opérations de recette sont à ce jour réalisées de manière manuelle et les briques d'automatisation initiées restent fragmentées, l'équipe QA interne étant fortement sollicitée par la charge opérationnelle.

Nous recherchons un QA Automaticien Senior H/F disposant d'un socle technique solide et sachant s'appuyer sur les outils d'Intelligence Artificielle pour consolider l'existant, accélérer le développement et sécuriser chaque livraison majeure du client.


Missions Principales

  • Élaboration de la Stratégie d'Automatisation : Auditer les briques existantes chez le client, définir l'architecture cible et concevoir un framework unifié adapté à l'environnement Salesforce.
  • Consolidation & Génération de Tests Boostée par l'IA : Assembler les scripts éparpillés et accélérer la rédaction ainsi que la maintenance des tests de non-régression à l'aide des outils d'IA.
  • Sécurisation des Déploiements Client : Orchestrer et exécuter la suite de tests automatisés en amont de chaque mise en production ou livraison majeure.
  • Support à l'Équipe QA Client : Travailler en synergie avec la QA fonctionnelle en place pour la décharger des exécutions manuelles répétitives.

Profil recherché : 

  • Expertise Technique & Outillage : Background technique solide en automatisation et maîtrise reconnue des standards du marché (ex. Selenium, Playwright, Provar, Cypress).
  • Maîtrise de l'écosystème Salesforce : Expérience éprouvée sur la plateforme Salesforce (interfaces Lightning, flux métier, modèle de données).
  • Appétence & Practique de l'IA : Utilisation courante de l'IA (génération de code/scripts, création de jeux de données, analyse d'impact) au service du gain de productivité.
  • Maîtrise de l'Anglais : Anglais courant indispensable pour évoluer au sein du contexte international du client.
  • Soft Skills : Posture de consultant/bâtisseur, autonomie, rigueur et excellente capacité à structurer un projet de A à Z.
